_about: Chart set for scripts/eval-readings.mjs. Each chart targets one axis the 23 Jul 1999 Epping reference chart does not cover. `birth` is passed through parseBirthDataInput (tzName resolved DST/LMT-aware, exactly as /api/calculate does). `expect` is checked by `npm run eval -- --verify`, which recomputes every chart with calculateDualChart and fails if a chart no longer hits its axis. `verified` records the placements that verify printed when the set was chosen (tropical, local-Meeus Pluto). Incidental features (a second cusp planet, a near-station planet) are listed by --verify for every chart, so a failure on one axis can be told apart from another.
